description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order to declare the excisable articles which are exempt from the payment of Excise (Special Provisions) Duty w.e.f. 16.05.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification contains an order made under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989, which exempts certain excisable articles from payment of Excise (Special Provisions) Duty. The content focuses on regulatory matters, statutory instruments, and legal provisions rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories. This fits the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it deals with regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements under existing legislation.
